name: Rakta Dark Dagger
tradeable: unranked copies only, with no Forma or Catalyst installed

groups.activity: pledge Red Veil, earn standing from mission affinity and Syndicate Medallions
groups.meta: 365,000 standing total to Exalted plus the dagger
groups.mode: leave around round 8 for one clean daily cap

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 2 at Rank 4 Revered, 3 at Rank 5 Exalted

conditions: Daily standing cap is 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, shared across every faction syndicate.
Hit the cap with mission affinity first, then turn in Syndicate Medallions and pick up Syndicate Alert rewards; neither counts toward the cap.
Rank up as soon as you can afford it. Standing earned past a rank's maximum is wasted, and medallions turned in near the cap are wasted the same way.
bonuses: Pledging Steel Meridian feeds Red Veil passively at +50% without hurting Suda or Hexis, if you want to keep those positive too.
The Circuit past stage 4, or a Sedna/Adaro stealth Exterminate with Equinox, Ivara or Banshee, also caps you in one or two runs.

disclosures.title: why 365,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to Exalted. Exalted's own cap is 132,000, which is enough to also bank the 125,000-standing weapon purchase without an extra rank-up cycle.

conditions: The free item you pick at each rank-up can never be a Syndicate weapon; the dagger is always a separate 125,000-standing purchase.
